mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE year_list AS ( SELECT YEAR(CURDATE()) - 4 AS key_year UNION ALL SELECT key_year + 1 FROM year_list WHERE key_year + 1 <= YEAR(CURDATE()) ), proc_data AS ( SELECT YEAR(buy_time) AS key_year, COALESCE(SUM(`count`), 0) AS value FROM XFPT_PROC_SUMMARY WHERE (dept_id = #{deptId} OR FIND_IN_SET(#{deptId}, ancestors)) AND del_flag = '0' AND buy_time IS NOT NULL AND YEAR(buy_time) BETWEEN YEAR(CURDATE()) - 4 AND YEAR(CURDATE()) GROUP BY YEAR(buy_time) ) SELECT CAST(yl.key_year AS CHAR) AS `key`, COALESCE(pd.value, 0) AS value FROM year_list yl LEFT JOIN proc_data pd ON yl.key_year = pd.key_year ORDER BY yl.key_year DESC

WITH RECURSIVE year_list AS ( SELECT YEAR(CURDATE()) - 4 AS key_year UNION ALL SELECT key_year + 1 FROM year_list WHERE key_year + 1 <= YEAR(CURDATE()) ), proc_data AS ( SELECT YEAR(buy_time) AS key_year, COALESCE(SUM(money), 0) AS value FROM XFPT_PROC_SUMMARY WHERE (dept_id = #{deptId} OR FIND_IN_SET(#{deptId}, ancestors)) AND del_flag = '0' AND buy_time IS NOT NULL AND YEAR(buy_time) BETWEEN YEAR(CURDATE()) - 4 AND YEAR(CURDATE()) GROUP BY YEAR(buy_time) ) SELECT CAST(yl.key_year AS CHAR) AS `key`, COALESCE(pd.value, 0) AS value FROM year_list yl LEFT JOIN proc_data pd ON yl.key_year = pd.key_year ORDER BY yl.key_year DESC

WITH all_xfpl AS ( SELECT 0 AS xfpl_code, '春秋装' AS xfpl_name UNION ALL SELECT 1 AS xfpl_code, '夏装' AS xfpl_name UNION ALL SELECT 2 AS xfpl_code, '冬装' AS xfpl_name UNION ALL SELECT 3 AS xfpl_code, '礼服' AS xfpl_name UNION ALL SELECT 4 AS xfpl_code, '运动装' AS xfpl_name UNION ALL SELECT 5 AS xfpl_code, '其他' AS xfpl_name ) SELECT a.xfpl_name AS `key`, COALESCE(t.total_sets, 0) AS value FROM all_xfpl a LEFT JOIN (
SELECT s.XFPL AS xfpl_code, SUM(s.GMTS) AS total_sets FROM XFPT_TEAM_MEETING m INNER JOIN XFPT_TEAM_MEETING_SON s ON m.id = s.TEAM_MEETING_ID
and (m.dept_id = #{deptId} or find_in_set(#{deptId},m.ancestors))
GROUP BY s.XFPL ) t ON a.xfpl_code = t.xfpl_code ORDER BY total_sets DESC;

WITH RECURSIVE month_list AS ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 11 MONTH), '%Y-%m-01') AS month_start UNION ALL SELECT DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(month_start, INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m-01') FROM month_list WHERE month_start < DATE_FORMAT(CURDATE(), '%Y-%m-01') ), trend_data AS ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(oi.pay_time, oi.create_time), '%Y-%m-01') AS month_start, ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(item.unit_price, 0)), 2) AS value FROM xfpt_order_info oi INNER JOIN xfpt_order_item item ON oi.id = item.order_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON oi.school_id = d.dept_id WHERE COALESCE(oi.pay_time, oi.create_time) IS NOT NULL AND (d.dept_id = #{deptId} OR FIND_IN_SET(#{deptId}, d.ancestors)) AND COALESCE(oi.pay_time, oi.create_time) >= DATE_FORMAT(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 11 MONTH), '%Y-%m-01') AND COALESCE(oi.pay_time, oi.create_time) < DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m-01') GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(oi.pay_time, oi.create_time), '%Y-%m-01') ) SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ml.month_start, '%Y-%m') AS `key`, COALESCE(td.value, 0) AS value FROM month_list ml LEFT JOIN trend_data td ON ml.month_start = td.month_start ORDER BY ml.month_start
